verdict.rationale: Granola explicitly captures audio from the device's system audio rather than joining as a visible bot ('Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot'), and works across Zoom, Meet, Teams etc., matching the founder's requirement of no visible external bot. It also posts a transparency notice in-chat when transcribing, showing awareness of participant visibility. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification (beyond vendor docs/marketing) confirming no bot artifact appears to external participants across all platforms.
